title: log3gpp: Build the packet record at the end of parse_line.
description:
Function parse_line currently collects a bunch of information about the parsed
line, and, upon success, callsites use the collected information to build a
packet in 'rec'.  Rather than have both callsites manage all those variables
and arguments, let's roll it into parse_line, eliminating another round of
duplicated code and declarations.

In theory, build_packet_record could be expanded directly into
parse_line_into_record, but that might become unwieldy.


(cherry picked from commit 73fd1cde94883c1b7fc431dfe41a13e523a0f000)

Co-authored-by: Darius Davis <darius-wireshark@free-range.com.au>
